description: Advanced algebra fluency for honors/AP-prep pathways

cards.back: Conjugate is a-bi. Product with conjugate gives a^2+b^2.
Multiply numerator and denominator by conjugate of denominator.
Remainder of dividing f(x) by (x-c) is f(c).
(x-c) is factor of f(x) iff f(c)=0.
Possible rational roots are factors of constant term over factors of leading coefficient.

cards.front: End behavior from degree and leading coefficient
cards.back: Even degree: both ends same direction. Odd degree: ends opposite. Leading sign sets up/down direction.
Functions are inverses if f(g(x))=x and g(f(x))=x on valid domains.
Condense logs first, rewrite in exponential form, solve, then check domain restrictions.
y = a*b^t with b>1 models multiplicative growth.
[f(x+h)-f(x)]/h measures average rate and leads to derivative in calculus.
Compare left and right limits at boundary and ensure they equal function value.
For y=a/(x-h)+k, vertical asymptote x=h and horizontal asymptote y=k.
Recursive uses prior term(s); explicit gives direct formula for nth term.
C(n,k) counts ways to choose k items from n without order.
